verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, and a built-in AI assistant you delegate tasks to is not a capability this kind of hardware ships, so the story is a category error. The pack's generic AI marketing ('gateway to breakthrough AI experiences') and the developer-facing Ryzen AI Software link describe no assistant inside the product. Ryzen Master is a tuning utility, not an agent, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
